★Request
Time passes
Display Red Desire (Summer Uniform) (no nosebleed)

■Direction Note
SE: Sound of multiple brooms falling over

Yes... It's just that the falling brooms
happened to hit me... Oh?

Ah, heavens! The "Scripture" meant to teach me
the ways of the otherworld... Could it truly be lost...?!

Fufu, they are runes♪ As a saint, reading and writing
mystical scripts is second nature to me. ...Oh my, what did this mean again?
(Clatter, clatter, bang—!!)
I see... Is that, so...?
I managed to find "The Medieval Carrot Compendium" and "Ancient Castles of the World," but for some reason, the "Dictionary of Legends Pertaining to Umamusume" is nowhere to be found.

"Thou shalt not falter at a trifle such as this"—
That is the divine message bestowed upon me!

...Red Desire faces any misfortune positively as a "trial."
Her incredible mental fortitude is honestly something to admire.

...
Still, it has become quite a mess, hasn't it?

Oh my...! You would walk alongside me through this trial?!
Then first—could you pick up that mop over there?

Even so—fufu. This proves it once more.
That I have been summoned from another world as a saint.

No, please do not fret. I shall locate it with my saintly powers.
The mana of that tome is—ah! I sense it, from that bookshelf...!

Indeed! No matter the hardship, I shall never fall to my knees!
I will overcome this trial without fail!

—Hark, troubled Umamusume.
The Saint of Salvation has descended before you this very moment.

Huh? Uhh... does that mean you'll do it for me?
Ah, but I'm in a rush so that's a huge help! Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!
Eeeek?!
For I am—the saint destined to save "that land"!
A few days after becoming Red Desire's trainer, seeing her everyday routine made me realize once again just how genuine her longing for "another world" truly was.

Hmph! Hah! ......Phew. It's not opening easily at all.
—Ah! Could this also be a... trial bestowed upon the saint?!

Fufu, please do not worry. When concocting it,
I shall refine it into a delicious potion with holy power!

...No! Surely this too is a trial to reach "that land"!
I will find it no matter what!

Yet fear not. I shall overcome this trial.
As the saint who will reach "that land"—!

Hah! Yah! Nnnngggghhh~~...!!
—!! I did it, it's open!!
Owwie~~...

Trainer... It seems I am being impeded.
By the workings of a grand destiny, from "unsealing" that locker...!

Desire-san, what language are you writing in that notebook?
I've never seen those letters before.

It's true that swertia and Isodon japonicus can be grown at home.
But they're really, really bitter, you know?
While walking down the hallway, I spotted Red Desire locked in a fierce struggle with a cleaning locker.

Ah, geez! I want to put the mop away, but it won't open!
Everyone just shoves things in so carelessly!

—First, let us set the long-handled tools to the side.
And place the lighter items at the bottom, yes.

Both the broom collision and the scattered tools—...
Are all "trials" bestowed upon this saint!
For I am—the saint chosen by destiny!

That door, bound tight in seal...
I shall unleash it with the power of a saint.

Oh, good day, Trainer.
Truth be told, I am searching for a book.

Fortunately, she was not seriously hurt,
and after some quick first aid, the nosebleed stopped right away.
